## Python — `mlflow/gateway/providers/utils.py`
- Added the exported constant `SUPPORTED_ACCEPT_ENCODING = "gzip, deflate, identity"`.
- Modified `_aiohttp_post` so that before creating the `aiohttp.ClientSession` it strips any incoming `Accept-Encoding` header (case-insensitively) and sets a single `Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, identity`, while preserving `Authorization` and all other headers.

## New hook — `mlflow/server/js/src/gateway/hooks/useTryIt.ts`
- `useTryIt({ tryItRequestUrl })` built on React Query's `useMutation` (so it requires a `QueryClientProvider`).
- Returns `{ data, error, isLoading, sendRequest, reset }`.
- `sendRequest(body)` parses the body; invalid JSON → error `'Invalid JSON in request body'` and **no** `fetchOrFail` call.
- On success, `data` is the response body pretty-printed via `JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2)`.
- On a `NetworkRequestError`/subclass carrying a `response`, `error.message` is the error's own message and `error.responseBody` is the response text pretty-printed. On a generic `Error`, only `error.message` is set (`responseBody` undefined). Uses a `TryItRequestError extends Error` so the structural `{ message, responseBody? }` contract is met without a `no-throw-literal` violation.

## Component — `EndpointUsageModal.tsx`
- Added a view-mode selector with radio options **Try it / cURL / Python**, defaulting to **Try it**.
- The Try it panel shows a **Request** editor, a **Send request** button, a **Response** area, and a **Reset example** button.
- Per-tab/variant/provider request configs drive the request URL and default body: Unified MLflow → `.../gateway/{endpoint}/mlflow/invocations`; Unified OpenAI Chat Completions → `.../gateway/mlflow/v1/chat/completions` (body includes `model`, `messages`, endpoint name); Passthrough OpenAI (`model`), Anthropic (`max_tokens`+`messages`), Gemini (`contents`).
- Only one code block renders for the currently active variant when cURL/Python is selected.
- Response/error state is cleared on tab switch, provider switch, modal reopen (via `open` effect), and Reset example.
